_comment: The ONNX files production loads. Single source of truth: read by required-models.ts (the boot check) and by scripts/upload-model-assets.js. __tests__/required-models.test.ts cross-checks it against the .onnx literals in inference/*.ts, so adding a model without listing it here fails. `bucketPrefix` is the object-storage folder the same files live in, shared by the loader and scripts/upload-model-assets.js.
_commentConstants: `constantsRequired` is the constants set the runtime loader expects under `constantsPrefix`, and exists so the upload can be verified AFTER the tree copies are deleted — at which point nothing else in the repo knows what the set should contain. It is a list of filenames only, no vendor data. __tests__/required-models.test.ts cross-checks it against the tree while the tree still exists, so it cannot drift before the cut.
